body:
### Summary

I'm not sure what other context I can add, but `uv self update` is not picking up version 0.12.3, instead claiming that 0.12.2 is the newest. The `--system-certs` flag is of no help, unlike in #18701.

[Logs](https://pastebin.com/jQB7RSAc)

### Platform

Microsoft Windows [Version 10.0.26200.8973]

### Version

uv 0.12.2 (46ead6098 2026-08-05 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)

### Python version

Python 3.14.7
title: `uv self update` not picking up latest `uv` version
